description: Show an interactive visual preview of a saved sequence in clients that support MCP Apps. Displays its real nodes, connections, delays and branches; click an email step to preview its saved rendered email, including available A/B variants, at desktop or mobile width. Read-only: does not activate, enroll or send. Requires an explicit companyId to keep step previews pinned to the same company. Other clients receive the sequence data; use render_email for individual step HTML.

companyId.description: Target company ID from get_account. Remains fixed for all previews in this view.

name: preview_sequence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `preview_sequence` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequence.description: Saved sequence topology and email steps, as returned by get_sequence.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
